system.description: Your sire never performed the Transubstantiation of Seven on you, whether through ignorance, haste, or death before the rite could be completed. You have taken no step toward a blood bond with the Tremere Council of Seven, and your loyalty to the clan (if any) is entirely your own. Should other Tremere discover this oversight, expect to be hauled in for the belated rite and pointed questioning about why you never came forward yourself.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
